title: quercus rubra var. triloba
intro: Quercus rubra var. triloba, commonly known as the White Oak, is a variety of deciduous tree belonging to the Fagaceae family. The White Oak is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the White Oak are attributed to its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various health issues, including wound healing and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of the White Oak include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
